text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While accompanying Neo Universe and Zenno Rob Roy on a shopping trip, a suspicious street stall caught my eye—

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text:
Tonight is the Moon Viewing festival, isn't it? Hehehehe...
In that case, how about a Moon Rabbit?
choice_data_list: I'm not particularly looking for a rabbit, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The street vendor pointed smoothly into the distance.
There, the back of a white creature could be seen running away—
choice_data_list: Why is there a rabbit in the middle of town?!
Why is there a rabbit in the middle of town?!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
That is... the "Singularity."
An "EBE" that cannot be anchored to "Terra"...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
S-Singularity?
What's the matter, Uni-san...?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Eh, wha, where is this place...!?
I thought we were in the city...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe?
text_block_list.text:
Well? How's the wonderland I built!
Pretty stylish, ain't it~?
choice_data_list: Isn't this completely different from the usual vibe!?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"A 'distortion' of dimensions cannot be permitted.
I demand a return to 'LUNA.'"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Two Uni-sans?!
W-W-What is going on here?!
choice_data_list: I-I don't have a clue what's going on either...!
I-I have no idea what's going on either...!

text_block_list.name: Fake Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Hop, hop, hop! Look who's scaredy-catting~!
Man, this is hilarious~~!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Neo Universe brought you into the 'MAST'... 'Sorry.'"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, please don't apologize. After all—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
“—I love stuff like this!
Following a rabbit down into Wonderland...
it's like a dream fairy tale...!”

text_block_list.name: Rabbit
text_block_list.text:
"What!? You cheeky little...!
Then how about this!?!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
My body feels so light this time...!
Haaah~~, it's just like gravity magic...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
He, hehe... Yeah, "space jellyfish."
"PUKA"... "Feels good."

text_block_list.name: Rabbit
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I'm gonna slip away while I still can.
Like hell I'm sticking around to pound mochi on the moon~!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I-Isn't that really bad? At this rate, the world will stay all twisted...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Let us capture the rabbit.
We must restore peace and save the world...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Luminescence." Turning weightlessness into power—
An "Anti-Gravity Boost."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Let's hold hands.
So that during our 'parabolic flight,'
we don't get pulled into deep space.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes! Channeling power into my legs... charging magical output!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Sphira! Everyone together...!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Anti-Gravity Boost!!

text_block_list.name: Rabbit
text_block_list.text: S-S-S-So faaast!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the captured rabbit returned to the moon with a satisfied look, saying, "Earth really is a blast after all—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, I was back in the familiar town.
What on earth was that phenomenon just now...?

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text:
Did you enjoy your adventure with the rabbit?
Ah, no need to pay... Until next time.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
That was such a precious experience...!
Like being in a fairy tale... haaah~~.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... The "superconducting sensor" is reacting.
Rob Roy is "ENJI", isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...When the "celestial pattern" blurs the boundaries,
it's time for an 『adventure』... once more, with everyone.
choice_data_list: So you mean a similar phenomenon will happen again?
Haha... I'd believe it even if you told me it was all a dream.
Haha... I'd believe it even if you told me it was all a dream.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...When the "celestial pattern" blurs the boundaries,
it's time for an 『adventure』... once more, with everyone.
choice_data_list: So you mean a similar phenomenon will happen again?
Haha... I'd believe it even if you told me it was all a dream.
Haha... I'd believe it even if you told me it was all a dream.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
When the moon's "spatial waves" are disturbed,
a distortion occurs due to "coherence".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
..."Schumann resonance" might be possible.
Trial is "SX"... I'll try calling.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, another mysterious thing is happening, isn't it?
I-I will also... hnnngh~~...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Rob Roy, "Up Quark."
Neo Universe goes "fugugu" too... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Even in dreams, phenomena are merely extensions of the "Möbius strip."
Both the "Meteor Tour" and the "Crossing of the Voie Lactée" await.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
T-That sounds like such a fun event...!
Um, could you tell me more about it?!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... Sfera.
Neo Universe will "teach" you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Neo Universe and Zenno Rob Roy had a lively conversation about the unknown universe!
